summaryForNext: No goal met. Compose runs UAR but its healthcheck uses wget, which the curl-only image lacks, and its model settings are OpenAI and 384-dim. There is no k8s/ and no workflow. The know-me LKE cluster has a ready *.know-me.tools wildcard cert on argocd-gateway, but a hostname needs a gateway listener in the Argo-managed know-me-cluster repo plus a Cloudflare A record to 23.239.29.33 (uar. is taken). Decided: the UAR repo's CI publishes a multi-arch public image to ghcr.io/prometheus-ags; this repo deploys a pinned digest with Renovate bumps. Open for plan: hostname, who makes the DNS and listener changes, auth on the public endpoint (the open-quota risk), UI deploy, Token Plan terms. The adversarial review was skipped by the operator.
